_comment: SDXL object-removal workflow (ComfyUI API format). Same proven shape as replace_object.json. The init image is the context crop with an OBJECT-FREE coarse fill (OpenCV inpaint) already painted into the masked footprint, so the model refines a realistic background rather than re-imagining the object. The graph STRUCTURE lives here; backend/comfy_remove.py injects per-request VALUES by node id (never rebuilds the graph). Flow: load checkpoint -> encode prompts -> VAE-encode the coarse-filled crop -> restrict denoising to the (slightly expanded) footprint via SetLatentNoiseMask -> KSampler regenerates a seamless, lighting-consistent fill -> decode -> save. Surroundings stay fixed.

inputs.text: seamless empty background, photorealistic, no object
object, person, text, blurry, lowres, distorted, artifacts, seam, duplicate, watermark
